items.statement: Positive operating cash flow of INR26.8 crores and bank balance of INR87.6 crores as of 31st March 2025
items.quote: The company had achieved positive cash flow from its operations to the tune of INR26.8 crores, and we had a bank balance of INR87.6 crores as on 31st March.

items.statement: Debtor days reduced to 89 days from 103 days in FY25
items.quote: On the working capital front, we made good progress, especially receivables management improved noticeably with debtor days reducing to 89 days from 103 days.

items.statement: INR87 crores in fixed deposits is operational money from advance bookings of INR141 crores for current year sales
items.quote: We do have a fixed deposit of around INR87 crores as on 31st March 2025. But that money is currently are operational monies, which we are having pursuant to the advanced booking, which came to us for the current year sales, and we had an ABS of almost INR141 something, okay?

items.statement: Inventory funded only one-third by bank borrowings, rest from own accruals
items.quote: As of today, inventory is funded only 1/3 by the bank, rest is my own accruals.

items.statement: M3 Investment acquired 9.17% stake via preferential allotment and committed to provide equity whenever needed
items.quote: M3 Investment Pvt. Ltd. recently acquired 9.17% stake in SRG Housing through a preferential allotment.

items.statement: ESOP pool allocated over 50% to employees, INR 84 lakh expense provision in FY25
items.quote: We have also strengthened our leadership by appointing segment heads, hiring an experienced individual as CFO, and bringing around 60 interns from top IITs and IIMs to support our next phase of growth. Moreover, being L1 in around 38 categories out of 45 under NTPC-distributed rooftop programs for various Indian ministries highlights our strong position in the sector.

items.statement: ESOP cost to increase in absolute terms in FY26 but decrease as percentage of business
items.quote: So, Yes. ESOP cost is something given this was the first year and that was largely half of the year cost only in this year. But at the same point in time, as a percentage to the overall business, we foresee that to be reduced in terms of percentage as overall business, given the growth we foresee to see the growth trajectory as it is happening. But Yes, in terms of absolute numbers, yes, it will b

items.statement: Acquired remaining 60% stake in Teesta Spintex from other promoters in April at near book value to avoid related-party questions
items.quote: Because it was a related party, so we didn't want any questions or anything to be raised. So that's why we preferred to transfer it at cost or at least some margin on that.

items.statement: Improved receivable cycles and tighter inventory controls materially supported internal cash generation
items.quote: This year's strong performance also reflects prudent working capital management —a favourable mix characterized by improved receivable cycles and tighter inventory controls.

items.statement: Cash and bank balance of around ₹8 crores and current investments of around ₹8.5 crores as of March 25
items.quote: You can see cash and bank balance —around ₹8 crores. You can see the balance is there.

items.statement: May use preferential equity issue to fund part of ₹60 crore dyeing unit capex
items.quote: Majorly from internal accruals, with some portion through debt or a preferential equity issue.

items.statement: Accelerated inventory charge-off for FY25 was Rs 150-160 crore; adding it back would make PBT positive by ~Rs 40 crore
items.quote: It has been in the range of between Rs. 150 crores to Rs. 160 crores accelerated charge-off. So, if you add that back, then the PBT would be positive by about Rs. 40 odd crores.

items.statement: Accelerated charge-off for FY26 expected similar to FY25 at Rs 30-35 crore per quarter; FY26 is the last year of accelerated charge-offs
items.quote: The accelerated charge-off I would imagine would be similar, marginally plus or minus of the number as we have shared. So, on the why not in one go, we have end of consulted different consultants right from tax to different consultants about this, and auditors and lot of people involved in the process. And based on that advice we received from everyone that we decided to do it on a quarterly basis

items.statement: Debt reduction of Rs 37 crore achieved in FY25; on track for Rs 100 crore reduction over two years but evaluating further investment needs due to market changes
items.quote: We are on track, and we wish to achieve the guidance that we have given. However, considering the market changes with respect to the big four entry, we are constantly evaluating the requirement of any further investment, and we will keep you updated on the same.

items.statement: Management is exploring strategic stake acquisition in select franchisee units to reshape the franchisee model and expand in-house manufacturing capacity.
items.quote: We are also exploring strategic stake acquisition in select franchisee units. This move is aimed to reshaping our franchisee model, while also contributing to the expansion of our in-house manufacturing capacity.

items.statement: INR45 crores received from a total preferential issue of INR97 crores; funds invested in franchisee units, office acquisition, and brand strengthening per issue objectives.
items.value: INR45 crores received from INR97 crores total
items.quote: So far, we have received INR45 crores from the total preferential issue of INR97 crores. And it has been invested in the franchisee unit and there are certain other expenditures for acquiring the office and brand strengthening, which as per the objective of that issue, we are using that fund.

items.statement: Trade receivables of INR67 crores as of March 2025; INR11-12 crores of delayed Q3 managed services receivables realized by mid-May 2025
items.quote: Our receivable position as of March 2025 stands at around INR67 crores on a consolidated basis, and we have realized close to INR11 crores from therein, which got delayed, like I said, from Q3.

items.statement: Cash and bank balance of INR25 crores plus INR67 crores receivables and INR7 crores depreciation equals ~INR100 crores liquidity position
items.quote: From a liquidity standpoint, yes, the company has a very robust liquidity position and the arithmetic that we just did close to INR100 crores of overall position, that definitely gives us confidence to make investments like what we are doing already in our Sales and Product teams.

items.statement: Consolidated operating cash flow post working capital changes was INR283 crores in Q4 FY25, converting EBITDA of INR225 crores at 127%.
items.quote: cash flow from operations, pos t working capital change at INR283 crores would mean that we have been able to convert EBIT DA of INR225 crores by 127% to arrive at INR283 crores

items.statement: Standalone India business generated positive cash flow post working capital changes of INR132 crores in Q4 FY25.
items.quote: we could generate positive cash flow post working capital changes of INR132 crores

items.statement: Full year FY25 consolidated operating cash flow post working capital changes was almost INR842 crores.
items.quote: from the EBITDA of INR717 crores, we ha ve been able to generate a good amount of positive cash flow post-operation, post working capital changes at almost INR842 crores

items.statement: Listing of subsidiary Jain Farm Fresh Foods is a probability under discussion with private equity partner; no decision taken yet.
items.quote: I think those discussions are -- that's a probability. And in c onsultation with the private equity partner we have, I think we will be taking some decision in that regard through the Board of that company

items.statement: Trade receivables reduced from INR 90 crore to INR 68 crore despite 18% turnover increase
items.quote: We have last year's trade receivables of, as you may recall, some of them who attended our regular earnings calls , that we have trade receivables of INR 90 crore in the last year, wh ich has been now reduced substantially to INR 68 crore.

items.statement: Cash and cash equivalents stood at INR 29 crore as of March 31, 2025
items.quote: On the liquidity front, w e close d the year with cash and cash equivalent of INR 29 crores , reflecting ample headroom to fund operations and the growth initiatives.

items.statement: Cash reserves stood at Rs. 349 crores as of March 31, 2025
items.quote: As of March 31st, 2025, our cash reserve stood at Rs. 349 crores.

items.statement: Preferential issue raised INR 33.24 crores; most used for working capital, 25-30% reserved for future bank guarantees
items.quote: recently when we did the preferential issue, we raised a total of INR 33.24 crores by diluting around 3 Lakh shares. So out of those INR33 crores, most of it were used for working capital, then another 25%, 30% of it is still lying with us for the future bank guarantees

items.statement: Debtor days reduced from 160-180 to 90-120 days over last 2-3 financial years
items.quote: earlier, if you see the last 2 or 3 financial years, the debtor days was close to 160, 180, which has come down to a total receivable cycle of 90 to 120

items.statement: Preferential issue raised INR 33.24 crores by diluting around 3 lakh shares
items.quote: recently when we did the preferential issue, we raised a total of INR 33.24 crores by diluting around 3 Lakh shares

items.statement: Land for planned university is held in promoter names and not yet transferred to company
items.quote: The land is already secured, but that is in my name and other promoter's name, yet to be transferred to the company's name, subject to availability of funds.

items.statement: Trade receivables at Rs 21.57 crore; negative Rs 5.2 crore cash flow from receivables changes
items.quote: My first question is the balance sheet shows trade receivables at Rs. 21.57 CR. And the cash flow statement reflects a negative Rs. 5.2 CR due to changes in receivables.

items.statement: 90% of prior year Rs 16.37 crore receivables recovered; new billings in Jan-March will be collected in 6-8 months
items.quote: But if you go through the balance sheet that this Rs. 16 CR, out of this Rs. 16 CR, we have already recovered almost 90% we have recovered. And now again the new booking which have made at the end of the financial year in Jan, Feb and March, whatever we have claimed to the government, that lies as a trade receivable, majorly from government. And that we will receive by 6 months or 6 to 8 months we

items.statement: Major operational jump required borrowing to fund expansion and higher expenditure
items.quote: And cash flow, in terms of cash flow as because this year we have a major jump in terms of operation, s o we have to go for some borrowing because we have to expand a lot. The expenditure also increased in comparison to last year

items.statement: Plan to raise capital in future to fund university construction after using internal reserves
items.quote: So, from that we can generate additional fund to procure the, actually to complete the buildings and the fixtures and other things, as well as we also have planned to raise capital in future for the rest of the funds.

items.statement: APL stake sale does not change business relationship or pricing
items.quote: I think as these objectives have been met, I think we don't see any significant change in their divesting of their holding in Shankara.

items.statement: APL contributes approximately 42% of revenue, mostly from channel and enterprise segments
items.quote: APL will come approximately around 42 percentages as APL. The bulk of it comes from channel and enterprise and rest from retail.

items.statement: Overall operating cash flow for FY25 is around Rs 90 crores
items.quote: Overall is around 90 crores is the overall operating cash flow.

items.statement: Bill discounting at Rs 400 crores and borrowing at Rs 72 crores as of March 2025
items.quote: in March, we are around 400 cores was the total bill discounting and borrowing was approximately around 72 crores, around 470 crores is the total borrowing as on end of March.

items.statement: Raised Rs 10.2 crore via preferential allotment of 7.6 lakh shares at Rs 131 each, subscribed by promoters and Saint Capital Fund, Mauritius
items.quote: In the fourth quarter we raised Rs. 10.2 crores through preferential allotment. We issued 7.6 lakh equity shares at Rs. 131 each. These were subscribed mainly by the promoters and Saint Capital Fund, Mauritius.

items.statement: Operating cash flow was negative INR 12 crores in FY25 due to unbilled revenue; management expects improvement to INR 4-5 crores in upcoming months
items.quote: As you know, currently our operating cash flow is around INR 12 crores negative and the primary reason for this is booking of the unbilled revenue which has not yet been converted into actual cash.

items.statement: Company raised Rs 55 crore and spent approximately Rs 10 crore on capital expenditures so far
items.quote: The Company has begun making new investments, which are taking shape. So far, out of Rs. 55 crores raised, approximately Rs. 10 crores have been spent on capital expenditures.

items.statement: Operating cash flow for FY25 was INR19.23 crores
items.quote: Our cash flow from operating activities stood at INR19.23 crores.

items.statement: Cash and investments on books are roughly INR136 crores
items.quote: Currently, we have cash and investments of roughly INR136 crores on the book.

items.statement: Promoter acquired shares worth roughly INR3 crores post-IPO
items.quote: Post IPO, I have also done a further acquisition of shares for roughly INR3 crores and that basically demonstrates my personal confidence in the company and its future growth trajectory.

items.statement: Company has 1 lakh shares remaining to grant under existing 2018 ESOP plan; dilution occurs on exercise over 3-4 year vesting period
items.quote: We are still left with around 1 lakh shares to be granted. Post that the company will again come up with some other, with the next plan, then we will have some impact on dilution and all. Dilution is on exercise basically, so as the employees exercise that time, we will have dilution.

items.statement: ESOP expense for FY25 was Rs 51 lakhs; FY26 expense depends on actuarial valuation based on market price
items.quote: the calculation of ESOP is based on the actua rial valuation. So actuary value when they give us, yearly, we get a valuation report from the actuary. They check the current market price and accordingly, they do a calculation and send it to us

items.statement: Deferred tax reversal of Rs 2 crores remaining on balance sheet; utilization timing depends on auditor assessment and full-year visibility
items.quote: So still we have some deferred tax in the asset which is around Rs. 2 crores or so. So in the next year, when it will be utilized that time it will be reversed.

items.statement: Company has sufficient net owned funds for RBI requirements; capital needs met through internal accruals and banking limits
items.quote: We have capital, we also have borrowed, we have banking limits through which we drive our business because capital requirements are always there in our business, the higher we grow we will have requirements.

items.statement: Pune JV plant is ready and commercial production will start shortly with validation batches expected to complete within 10 days.
items.quote: The Pune facility is now operational and commercial production will start shortly. Validation batches are underway and are expected to be completed within the next days 10 days.

items.statement: Pune JV order book covers next 90 days and first year capacity utilization expected at 60-65%.
items.quote: First year, we'll be doing around 60% to 65% of the capacity utilization, and that is very well on track. And in the beginning, we have told that the order books are also in place for first 90 days.

items.statement: Working capital cycle improved in FY25 and will continue on an improving trend.
items.quote: So, we have improved a bit on our working capital cycle, if you see the numbers. And going forward also, we will be on an improving trend only.

items.statement: Company maintains debt-free balance sheet with cash reserve of approximately ₹29 crore
items.quote: Despite these challenges, I am proud to emphasize that we maintain a robust financial position with a debt -free balance sheet and a cash reserve of approximately ₹29 crore.

items.statement: FY25 retail operating cash flow was Rs 44 crores
items.quote: Because if I look at your FY '25 operating cash flow in the retail business, it's closer to Rs. 44 odd crores, right
